intent: Give the supporting line under an item's title in muted text.
typical_uses: The muted detail under an ItemTitle, such as a size, a date or a status

dont_use_when.situation: The supporting line under a bounded panel's title
The explanation in a placeholder for a region with nothing to show

invariants.text: ItemDescription renders a p with no margin in the muted foreground color; a link inside it is underlined and takes the link color on hover. By default it is cut with an ellipsis after two lines and carries no inline style. `lineClamp` sets another line count, written inline as the private `--_item-line-clamp` custom property and rounded down to whole lines; `"none"`, a count below 1 or a non-finite count shows the full text with no clamp and no hidden overflow. A long unbroken token wraps inside the description (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`) at every line count instead of being cut at its edge. Every value keeps the item's media top-aligned.

rtl.by: item.module.css sets `.itemDescription { text-align: left }`, a physical alignment, so under a right-to-left direction the description stays aligned to the left edge while the title follows the direction

lineClamp.states: lineClamp is the number of lines shown before the text is cut with an ellipsis, or "none" for the full text
lineClamp.because: ItemDescriptionProps types it as `number | 'none'`, a union of a number and a string literal that the compiler emits no single JSON type for, so nothing is asserted beyond the default of 2.

good.title: A description with an inline link
A long description shown in full
good.code:
<ItemContent>
  <ItemTitle>Retention policy</ItemTitle>
  <ItemDescription lineClamp="none">
    Messages older than ninety days move to the archive, and archived
    messages are deleted after a year unless a legal hold applies.
  </ItemDescription>
</ItemContent>

bad.title: Block content nested in the description
bad.why: ItemDescription is a p, and HTML does not allow a div inside a p; keep it to phrasing content such as text, links and inline elements.

lineClamp.description: Partially typed: number | "none" | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property and none for this one; shape checked by tsc, see x-uikit.partially_typed_props. lineClamp is the number of lines shown before the text is cut with an ellipsis, or "none" for the full text. ItemDescriptionProps types it as `number | 'none'`, a union of a number and a string literal that the compiler emits no single JSON type for, so nothing is asserted beyond the default of 2.
